name: SF Open Data API
tagline: Socrata SODA API for San Francisco open datasets and civic applications
description: San Francisco's official open-data portal provides hundreds of city datasets through Socrata SODA, including tabular and geospatial civic data. Public SODA 2.1 resource reads require no authentication; an optional app token identifies the application and provides higher throttling limits. SODA 3 queries require an app token or user authentication.

auth.details: Optional app token via X-App-Token header (or app_token query param); unauthenticated access allowed at lower limits. Register an app on the portal for a token.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public SODA 2.1 reads are free. No fixed numeric cap is published; app-token requests are currently unthrottled unless abusive or malicious, while anonymous requests use a lower shared-IP throttling pool.

rate_limits: No fixed numeric limit is published. App-token requests are currently unthrottled except for abusive or malicious use; anonymous requests may be throttled by source IP. Throttling returns HTTP 429.
use_cases: query SF crime incidents by neighborhood and date
list recent building permits for a parcel or address
fetch city budget or department spending tables
get geospatial datasets for maps and civic apps
